questions.question: Three of the following four are alike in a certain way and form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
questions.explanation: Triangle, rectangle and square are two-dimensional plane figures. A cube is a three-dimensional solid, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Select the number that is different from the rest.
questions.explanation: 15 = 3 × 5, 21 = 3 × 7 and 33 = 3 × 11 are all composite (and multiples of 3). 37 is a prime number, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Three of the following four are alike in a certain way. Which one is different?
questions.explanation: Copper, silver and gold are pure metals (elements). Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Select the number that does NOT belong with the others.
questions.explanation: 24, 36 and 48 are all multiples of 12. 50 is not divisible by 12, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Select the letter cluster that is different from the rest.
questions.explanation: In CFI, GJM and KNQ each letter is 3 places after the previous one (+3, +3). In PRT the step is +2, +2, so it is the odd cluster.

questions.question: Select the number pair that is different from the others.
questions.explanation: In each pair the second number is the cube of the first: 3³ = 27, 4³ = 64, 5³ = 125. But 6³ = 216, not 180, so (6, 180) is the odd pair.

questions.question: Three of the following are alike. Which is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Guitar, violin and sitar are stringed instruments. A flute is a wind instrument, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Select the word that does NOT belong with the others.
questions.explanation: Hockey, cricket and football are outdoor field sports played with a ball between two teams. Chess is an indoor board game, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Select the number that is different from the rest.
questions.explanation: 121 = 11², 144 = 12² and 169 = 13² are perfect squares. 180 is not a perfect square, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Three of these cities share a common feature. Which city is the exception?
questions.explanation: Kolkata, Mumbai and Chennai are coastal port cities. Bhopal is an inland city with no seaport, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Select the pair that is different from the others.
questions.explanation: In three pairs the worker is matched with the product he makes (shoes, furniture, clothes). 'Blacksmith : Iron' matches the worker with his raw material, not his product.

questions.question: Select the number that does NOT belong with the others.
questions.explanation: 7, 13 and 19 are prime numbers. 25 = 5 × 5 is composite, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Three of the following terms are related. Which one is unrelated?
questions.explanation: Radius, diameter and circumference are all measurements associated with a circle (a plane figure). Volume applies to a solid, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Select the letter pair that is different from the rest.
questions.explanation: In each pair the second letter is the mirror of the first from the end of the alphabet: A↔Z, B↔Y, C↔X. D should pair with W, not V, so D–V is the odd pair.

questions.question: Three of the following animals belong to one family. Which is the exception?
questions.explanation: Lion, tiger and leopard belong to the cat family (Felidae). A wolf belongs to the dog family (Canidae), so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Select the number that does NOT belong with the others.
questions.explanation: 27 = 3³, 64 = 4³ and 125 = 5³ are perfect cubes. 150 is not a perfect cube, so it is the odd one out.

questions.question: Three of the following go together. Which is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Pen, pencil and marker are instruments used for writing. An eraser is used to remove writing, so it does not belong.

questions.question: Select the month that is different from the others.
questions.explanation: January, March and May each have 31 days. November has 30 days, so it is the odd one out.
